license.redistribution_requirement: Retain copyright and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions.

exceptions.upstream_guidance: Demo layouts only; replace with your own assets for deliverables.

inventory.external_release_assets: README embeds release-hosted promotional images and videos; these are not git tracked files and are outside this repository snapshot.

verification.scope: Current working tree after local high-resolution derivatives; original acquisition evidence is retained in acquisition_verification

acquisition_verification.git_hash_method: SHA-1 of raw Git blob header plus exact working-tree bytes; directly matches each HEAD tree blob ID without normalization
acquisition_verification.checkout_eol_policy: Local core.autocrlf=false; original blobs restored via git cat-file --batch, then index refreshed without changing any tracked blob.

file_inventory_scope: files[] preserves original upstream acquisition hashes; current locally derived files are recorded by local_derivatives and quality-report/hd-library-manifest.json

local_derivatives.purpose: High-resolution reference library; replace low-resolution working images after full verification

source_changes.reason: Default DPR4 / JPEG98, reset specimen viewport after sheets, redraw Canvas backing at DPR, decode image dependencies before capture.
